title: A red Lamp lights nothing on a dark level
description: On a dark level, the player throws a lit bomb up under the Kissing Parlor's ceiling, and its red lamp falls. He picks the red Lamp up and carries it out of the shop into the dark: it casts no light of its own, the dark closes in round him as if he held nothing, and only the red tint shows.
